To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the communication infrastructure is a key component in the design of a fault-tolerant middleware; (2) a portable communication infrastructure can be designed and implemented; (3) fault injection is a useful and portable tool to validate and evaluate such a CI; (4) the CI is fault-tolerant and can tolerate communication faults; and (5) the CI is scalable and performs well in a large cluster.
the CI can tolerate all faults that we have been able to inject and that the CI has a very low fault rate.
In summary, our research is concerned with

developing a portable communication infrastructure for a fault-tolerant, cluster-based middleware that supports both application and middleware-level communication, and with the validation of this infrastructure and the underlying middleware.
the design and validation of a portable CI for a cluster middleware.
developing a fault-tolerant communication infrastructure that is portable across a range of communication technologies and is optimized for efficient cluster operation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the communication infrastructure and its associated middleware have performed very well.
the fault injection scheme is a valuable tool to validate the communication infrastructure and the middleware, as well as for evaluating the performance of the CI.
the communication infrastructure is robust to communication faults.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CI is portable, efficient and fault tolerant.
we have developed a communication infrastructure, that can handle the communication requirements of both the cluster management middleware as well as the application.
the CI and cluster middleware have proven to be highly fault-tolerant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the communication infrastructure is a critical component of cluster middleware and should be carefully designed and validated.
a portable communication infrastructure can be built on top of user-level message passing, and that it can be validated and evaluated with fault injection.
fault tolerance in communication is an important component of a fault-tolerant middleware and must be considered during the design of the middleware and its communication infrastructure.
